body:
**Goal.** Turn raw memos into stable merchant tokens, versioned, in one place.

## Scope
- SEPA boilerplate stripping and per-source-account profiles (package defaults, user overrides).
- `NORMALISER_VERSION`, recorded with every vector and in the version tuple.
- Raw memo preserved; normalisation never happens in an ofxstatement plugin.

## Done when (red→green)
Synthetic memos map to the expected tokens; a user profile overrides the package profile; changing a rule changes the version.

Synthetic data only: no real statement, memo, IBAN, document or correspondent name in any fixture.

**Depends on:** #22

**Design:** [proposal 0001](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/proposals/draft/0001-gnucash-auto-booking-pipeline.md) (*Normalisation*), [architecture ch.5](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/architecture/05-building-block-view.md)
